zh.d:
本版让 dream 引擎真正做到「边干边听」：回复进行中也能随时补充消息，引擎在下一步就把它并进当前任务；遇到需要你拍板的地方，会弹出选项卡片让你直接选，而不是把 A/B/C 写进正文后停下。内置模型依旧开箱即用，无需注册、无需粘贴 Key。

【新增】
· 【回复中途插话】1ONE CLI 回复时可以继续发消息补充信息，消息直接并入正在进行的任务，不必等它说完或先停止
· 【排队发送】回复中发出的消息排在输入框上方，发送前可随时编辑、删除或点「↑ 立即发送」；取代原来的草稿箱
· 【发送方式开关】设置中可选「立即插话」（默认）或「排队，回合结束后自动发送」
· 【团队作战】成员正在工作时也能直接发消息干预，消息即时送达该成员当前的任务
· 【AI 提问卡片】模型需要你做选择时，在输入框上方弹出选项卡片，点选即可继续
· 【聊天记录导出】标题栏可将当前会话导出为 Markdown；侧边栏支持导出所选或全部会话（ZIP，每个会话一个 .md）
· 【变更面板】未纳入版本控制的文件夹可一键「初始化版本控制」；新增、修改、删除的文件用不同颜色区分；每轮对话结束自动刷新改动列表
· 【项目文件夹】通过「添加文件夹到项目」挂上的文件夹，现在会一并告知 AI，问「项目里有什么」时不再只看工作目录

【优化改进】
· 【先做再问】引擎会先推断意图把事情做完，不再在回答末尾列一串「接下来要不要……」的菜单
· 【会话目录】新建临时会话的目录由 7 层压到 2 层：工作目录\conversations\日期\会话；已有会话路径不变
· 【企业连接】设置 → 企业身份改为一张「企业服务器」连接卡片，保存即探测并启用，地址栏给出域名示例

【修复】
· 修复所用模型被删除后，历史会话无法继续对话
· 修复消息的「投递中」标记偶尔一直不消失
· 修复更换工作目录或升级后，部分旧会话因临时目录不存在而打不开
· 修复非当天创建的临时会话不会挂载所选技能

企业部署完成一轮外部安全测试整改，并补齐员工编排、计费归属和管理员操作的多处细节。

【新增】
· 【数字员工】支持在线编写员工，市场同步改为并行；员工绑定按当前资源权限执行
· 【在线更新】企业服务端支持签名校验的在线更新
· 【模型渠道】管理员可用已保存的凭据直接探测渠道是否可用
· 【审计员】审计员可按授权范围只读查看，普通成员不再看到套餐明细

【优化改进】
· 【安全】跨域请求不再携带凭据；SSO 密钥加密存储；OAuth 与 SAML 回调绑定发起登录的浏览器
· 【账号】初始管理员密码不再写入日志，密码强度规则加强
· 【桌面客户端】统一称为「企业服务器」，连接方式简化为一张卡片

【修复】
· 修复开启强制 MFA 后所有管理员被锁在外面
· 修复管理员新建的成员未加入所在企业，以及历史成员用量未正确归属
· 修复项目组可重名、上传的 DreamEngine 员工包未绑定企业渠道、对象存储连接失败无明确原因
· 修复知识库重建排序报错与 MFA 管理列表字段格式

en.d:
The dream engine now listens while it works: you can add to a request mid-reply and the engine folds it into the task at its next step. When it needs your call, it shows a choice card instead of writing options into the reply and stopping. Built-in models still work out of the box, no sign-up and no API key needed.

[New]
· [Interject mid-reply] Keep sending messages while 1ONE CLI replies; they join the task in progress instead of waiting or forcing a stop
· [Queued messages] Messages sent during a reply line up above the composer, where you can edit, delete or send one now; replaces the draft box
· [Send setting] Choose between interjecting immediately (default) or queueing until the turn ends
· [Team mode] Message a busy teammate directly; it reaches the task they are working on
· [Question cards] When the model needs a decision, a choice card appears above the composer
· [Chat export] Export the current chat as Markdown from the title bar; export selected or all chats as a ZIP from the sidebar
· [Changes panel] Put an untracked folder under version control in one click; added, modified and deleted files are colour-coded; the list refreshes after every turn
· [Project folders] Folders added with "Add folder to project" are now made known to the agent

[Improved]
· [Act first] The engine infers intent and finishes the job instead of ending with a menu of follow-up options
· [Chat folders] New temporary chats live two levels deep (conversations\date\chat) instead of seven; existing chats keep their paths
· [Enterprise connection] Settings > Enterprise identity is now a single enterprise-server card that saves, probes and connects in one step

[Fixed]
· Chats whose model was deleted can be continued again
· The "delivering" mark on a message no longer sticks
· Older chats open again after the work directory changed or an upgrade moved their temporary folder
· Temporary chats created on an earlier day now get their selected skills linked

Enterprise deployments complete a round of fixes from an external security test, along with improvements to digital employees, usage attribution and admin operations.

[New]
· [Digital employees] Author employees online with parallel market sync; employee bindings run with current resource permissions
· [Online updates] The enterprise server supports signed online updates
· [Model channels] Admins can probe a channel with its stored credential
· [Auditors] Auditors get scoped read-only access; ordinary members no longer see plan details

[Improved]
· [Security] No credentialed cross-origin requests; SSO secrets encrypted at rest; OAuth and SAML callbacks bound to the initiating browser
· [Accounts] The initial admin password stays out of logs, with stronger password rules
· [Desktop client] Consistently called the enterprise server, with a single connection card

[Fixed]
· Mandatory MFA no longer locks every admin out
· Admin-created members join their company, and backfilled members' usage is attributed correctly
· Duplicate project-group names are rejected, uploaded DreamEngine packs bind to a company channel, and storage connection failures are named
· Fixed the knowledge-base rebuild ordering error and the MFA admin list field format
